description: This file is a shell script that contains a test suite for Git's 'show-ref' command. It sets up a test environment, performs various tests to verify the behavior of 'git show-ref' with different options and arguments, and checks the expected output and error handling.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with optional annotations, used for setting up test repository state.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a command or set of commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files or strings.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for pattern matches in output or error messages.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Schedules cleanup commands to run after tests complete.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a specific file path exists and is a file.

methods.name: remove_object
methods.description: Removes a specific Git object by SHA, for testing dangling refs.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
